parameters.name: BgpGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the BGP group to which the BGP peer that you want to query belongs.

parameters.name: BgpPeerId
parameters.description: The ID of the BGP peer that you want to query.

parameters.name: IsDefault
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the BGP group is the default BGP group. Valid values:


- **true**: The BGP group is the default BGP group.

- **false**: The BGP group is not the default BGP group.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the BGP group to which the BGP peer that you want to query belongs. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Virtual Border Router (VBR) associated with the BGP peer that you want to query.
